# Ridibooks

> Ridibooks is a Korean digital publishing platform offering e-books, webtoons, manga, and webnovels with exclusive deals, loyalty rewards, and curated recommendations.

Ridibooks (리디북스) is South Korea's leading digital content platform, featuring a diverse catalog of Korean and international comics, webtoons, romance novels, and e-books. The platform emphasizes user engagement through point rewards, time-limited promotions, and exclusive content partnerships.

## Key Topics

- Webtoons
- E-books
- Manga
- Webnovels
- Korean Comics
- Digital Content
- Ridi Points
- Ridi Cash
- Bestseller Rankings
- Event Promotions
- Loyalty Rewards
- Exclusive Deals
- Fantasy/SF
- BL Content
- Romance Genre

## Content Categories

- [E-book Recommendations](https://ridibooks.com/ebook/recommendation): E-book recommendations with monthly deals and bestseller lists
- [Manga & Webtoon Recommendations](https://ridibooks.com/comics/ebook): Manga and webtoon recommendations with bestsellers and discounts
- [Romance Webnovels](https://ridibooks.com/romance/webnovel): Korean romance webnovels with exclusive deals and free content
- [Fantasy & SF Webtoons](https://ridibooks.com/webtoon/fantasy): Fantasy and SF webtoons with bestsellers and free reading options
- [BL Webtoons](https://ridibooks.com/webtoon/bl): BL webtoon collection with exclusive content and rankings

## Promotions & Rewards

- [Point Night Event](https://ridibooks.com/event/3799): Time-limited point rewards event with coupon and bonus incentives
